what: The fields the judge reads from ESPN MLB scoreboard events, copied from live responses, plus the empty days and MLB's own schedule for the same dates.
method: Read on 2026-10-30 through the Cloudflare-side html_probe tool (the sandbox cannot reach ESPN or statsapi), with &limit=1 so the first event is in the first 3000 characters. Only the fields the judge reads are kept (id, date, name, event.season, competitions[0].type); the responses carry much more.
